title: The unbearable opaqueness of Arp220
question: What do vibrationally excited HCN emission and the HCN/HCO+ ground-state lines reveal about the morphology, physical structure, absorption and powering of the two nuclei of Arp 220?

data.sensitivity: Band 6 rms 1.1-1.3 mJy/beam per ~27-28 km/s channel; Band 7 ~1 mJy/beam per ~25-26 km/s channel

what.value: Nuclear FIR luminosities and dust properties used for L_vib/L_FIR

evidence.quote: We also present their ratios relative to the total luminosity of each nucleus as estimated by (cite: Wilson2014).

what.value: HC3N physical conditions used to estimate line blending contamination

evidence.quote: From the physical conditions derived by (cite: Mart’in2011), we infer for this line a peak flux density integrated over the whole source of $\sim20-40$ mJy

recipe.goal: Measure continuum fluxes and nuclear positions
recipe.method: Line-free channels give continuum per band; double Gaussian fit in image plane to the two nuclei

recipe.goal: Characterize absorption systems and nuclear velocities
recipe.method: Gaussian fit to unabsorbed HCO+ 3-2 channels, subtract, then multi-Gaussian fit to absorptions

recipe.goal: Fit HCN v2=1f lines de-blended from HCO+
recipe.method: Double Gaussian fit, and fit to residual after subtracting scaled HCN 3-2 profile

recipe.goal: Virial masses and gas surface densities
recipe.method: M_vir=250 dv^2 R with R~25-30 pc, f_g=0.1

recipe.goal: Size of vibrational emission and excitation analysis
recipe.method: Gaussian fits to integrated maps of HCN 4-3 v2=1f; LTE excitation temperature from 3-2/4-3; optically thick size limits
assumptions: LTE; T_vib 300 K or T_ex 40 K as limiting cases

evidence.quote: individual nuclear velocities of $V_{WN}=5342\pm4$ $\rm km\,s^{-1}$  and $V_{EN}=5454\pm8$ $\rm km\,s^{-1}$
individual nuclear velocities of $V_{WN}=5342\pm4$ $\rm km\,s^{-1}$  and $V_{EN}=5454\pm8$ $\rm km\,s^{-1}$

answer_key.quantity: Excitation temperature of HCN v2=1f (WN, EN)

evidence.quote: is $T_{\rm ex}\sim38$ K and $45$ K for the WN and EN, respectively
the HCN vibrational emission is confined to a barely resolved region of $\sim60\times50$ pc in the $4-3$ transition
we can establish lower limits to the emitting region of 15 pc (EN) and 22 pc (WN)

how the scaled HCN profile was chosen for HCO+ subtraction

score_reason: Public data and clear Gaussian-fit methods, but imaging parameters and de-blending details missing.
